ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Aditya Birla Lifestyle Brands Limited (ABLBL) reported a robust Q2 FY27, achieving double-digit revenue (11%) and substantial profit (126% PAT) growth, fueled by strong performance across Lifestyle and Emerging Brands, improved margins (60 bps expansion), and accelerated retail expansion. Despite a festival calendar shift impacting Q2 like-for-like sales, the company is confident in sustaining this momentum and further reducing net debt in H2. A potential yellow flag was observed in analyst queries regarding pre-IND-AS margin calculations, though management asserted overall margin expansion at all levels.
